correctness.rationale: Exact all-size proof: in a temporal-four return every active vertex must rotate at every update, and connectedness forces all vertices active unless the state is all rest. Fixing hub phase zero reduces the successor-neighbor condition to a 16-state pair transfer with 9-state forbidden-no-1 correction. Integer Faddeev-LeVerrier character polynomials give determinant factors (1+z^2)(1-z-2z^2-2z^3-z^4-z^5) and 1-z-z^2-z^3. Matrix-trace generating function then proves exact sequence and quintic growth. Actual standalone checkers independently reproduce characteristic polynomials/CH and directly enumerate all 4^(n+1) states for n=3..8. The asymptotic comparison uses rigorous unique-positive-root bracketing and spectral gaps; no basin claim is asserted.

value.rationale: Four-state excitable waves on wheel networks are a natural next-palette comparison after the exact three-state wheel enumeration. The invariant counts genuine temporal oscillators for every rim length, not an arbitrary small graph slice: it has an unexpectedly compact quintic-plus-tribonacci rational structure, gives complete all-length counts, and proves the concrete inversion that absolute orbit growth increases (2.335 vs 2.205) while uniform initial recurrence probability decreases faster (0.5838 vs 0.7352). The precise count is useful for comparing palette sensitivity, phase-wave complexity, and random-initialization rarity; it is not presented as a generic algorithmic transfer observation or a claim about complete basins.
